mapper.select: WITH ripple (node_id, probability, node_path) AS ( SELECT e.dependent_id, e.probability, changed.name || CHR(10) || dependent.name FROM node changed JOIN edge e ON e.dependency_id = changed.id JOIN node dependent ON dependent.id = e.dependent_id WHERE changed.name = #{target} AND e.probability >= #{minProbability} UNION ALL SELECT e.dependent_id, r.probability * e.probability, r.node_path || CHR(10) || dependent.name FROM ripple r JOIN edge e ON e.dependency_id = r.node_id JOIN node dependent ON dependent.id = e.dependent_id WHERE r.probability * e.probability >= #{minProbability} ) CYCLE node_id SET is_cycle TO 'Y' DEFAULT 'N' SELECT n.name AS node, n.kind, best.probability, best.node_path FROM (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.node_id ORDER BY r.probability DESC) AS path_rank FROM ripple r WHERE r.is_cycle = 'N') best JOIN node n ON n.id = best.node_id WHERE best.path_rank = 1 ORDER BY best.probability DESC, n.name
